interpretation.plain_speak: The warning signal transfers to a different rehearsal phase, but fixed hard boundaries do not transfer perfectly. Most flips still come from the fragile tail, yet STORE reaches rank 12 and REPORT rank 6 in a few cases. Wingless can trust 'lower margin means higher risk' more than it can trust one magic cutoff.
interpretation.north_star_question: Rejects brittle hard-band deficiency triggering while preserving the more general continuous vulnerability signal, narrowing the path toward robust internal self-detection.
interpretation.next_stage: on a new phase-17 context, preregister fixed vulnerability-rank bins and test whether crossing rate decreases monotonically with rank without fitting any threshold or triggering maintenance
